Through Christ, God is no longer the source of judgment, but now He is the source of all

Forgiveness of sins is wonderful, but what is it for?
Why does it matter that our sins are forgiven?
Is it so that we can feel better about ourselves, so that we don't have to carry these guilty

No.
Our problem is that ultimately that our sins separated us from God.
